node.title: Re^5: Problem with regex is a bug? or my regex
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I checked and can now confirm that the version where the behavior of your test script changes is [mod://Expect] v1.26, which is where I quoted the Changelog entry from above. Specifically, it's commits [https://github.com/jacoby/expect.pm/commit/7ee4816fd4a560ff0b9ee14c3f273222b215a8d3|7ee4816] and [https://github.com/jacoby/expect.pm/commit/d9e03655875b74792fbe1aaf9bcccd6540274c23|d9e0365] that each change the behavior of your script.

The problem actually turns out to be fairly simple: The position of a capturing group was changed. Previously, the module did /$pattern->[2]()/ where it now does /($pattern->[2])/, which changes the ordering of the capture groups and which breaks your \2 backreference. Change the backreference to \g-1 and your regex should work even on the newest version of [mod://Expect] (at least my testing shows that it does).
